# Captured Native publication metadata

These three Gradle Module Metadata files were generated by this project's
Kotlin Gradle Plugin 2.2.21 / Gradle 8.14.3 local publication. They retain the
original `kotlin-metadata` Native variants, including the distinction between
the underlying Gradle task filename and the customized Maven coordinate.

The gate regression tests substitute test-local versions, archive lengths and
digests while preserving the generated schema. No compiled cryptographic
binary is stored in this fixture. The corresponding rejection and fixed-gate
evidence is under `docs/round2/evidence/maven-gate/`.
